digest.component_or_area: pytest snapshot fixture lifecycle and teardown
propositions: Snapshot producers outside tests/unit/workflow/test_snapshot.py leave non-removable .rebar/run_snapshots trees because teardown cleanup is only in the module-local fixture
Production snapshots are intentionally published with 0444/0555 permissions by snapshot._chmod_readonly, making standard shutil.rmtree fail with PermissionError on residual cache roots

Shared pytest teardown must be relocated from module-local fixture to tests/conftest.py autouse fixture to guarantee cleanup of exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots below all test-owned tmp_path directories
The existing snapshot._rmtree_writable seam restores write permissions and removes read-only snapshot cache trees, enabling standard basetemp cleanup to succeed
Cross-module snapshot producer tests must leave read-only production snapshots during execution while ensuring all .rebar/run_snapshots cache roots become removable after shared teardown
